mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS course_review ( id BIGINT NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT, course_id BIGINT NOT NULL, user_id BIGINT NOT NULL, rating TINYINT NOT NULL, comment VARCHAR(500), create_time DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time DATETIME NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, PRIMARY KEY (id), UNIQUE KEY uk_user_course_review (user_id, course_id), KEY idx_course_review_course_id (course_id) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO course_review (course_id, user_id, rating, comment) VALUES (#{courseId}, #{userId}, #{dto.rating}, #{dto.comment}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE rating = VALUES(rating), comment = VALUES(comment), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT cr.id, cr.course_id AS courseId, cr.user_id AS userId, cr.rating, cr.comment, u.username, cr.create_time AS createTime FROM course_review cr LEFT JOIN `user` u ON cr.user_id = u.id WHERE cr.user_id = #{userId} AND cr.course_id = #{courseId}

SELECT cr.id, cr.course_id AS courseId, cr.user_id AS userId, cr.rating, cr.comment, u.username, cr.create_time AS createTime FROM course_review cr LEFT JOIN `user` u ON cr.user_id = u.id WHERE cr.course_id = #{courseId} ORDER BY cr.create_time DESC, cr.id DESC
